findings.now: So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds). If you take any medication, ask an AI whether it's one of them, since AI is pretty good at that (my full iboga guide here lists some of them, and the iboga microdosing protocol is here).
So this may not be a good time to jump into either one, though there's no need to leave the partner you have.

Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one:
within a day of starting it, psychedelics can hit some people a lot harder, visuals included, especially "hard heads" who usually need more than an average dose
It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.

If you're doing psychedelics, be especially strict around ayahuasca's harmala MAOI chemistry and around iboga or ibogaine. Even so, 5-HTP is fine the day before either one, or the day after ayahuasca.

After iboga, wait a day if it was a low dose and usually a few days otherwise, and after a flood dose (one big dose) people often wait weeks before taking anything psychoactive, mainly so they don't block the after-effects they took iboga for.
While you're microdosing iboga, leave 5-HTP out altogether.
Do not combine with serotonergic medications, ayahuasca/harmalas, iboga, MDMA, DXM, or tramadol.
Do not use with serotonergic medications/supplements, ayahuasca/harmalas, iboga, MDMA, DXM, or tramadol.
